# Anthony Mahler — Translation & Editing / Übersetzung & Lektorat

> German–English translator and editor based in Basel, Switzerland. Translation, editing, copyediting, and proofreading for the humanities, social sciences, arts, and museums: books, exhibition catalogues, scholarly essays, journal articles, and grant applications. Working since 2015 with German-speaking authors, academic presses, art publishers, museums, and universities in Switzerland, Germany, Austria, and internationally.

## Services

- Translation, German to English: full monographs, exhibition and collection catalogues, art theory and artists' writings, philosophy and literary theory, journal articles and edited volumes, grant applications.
- Editing of English-language manuscripts, including texts by nonnative authors and machine translations: developmental editing, line editing, copyediting, proofreading.
- In German: Übersetzung Deutsch–Englisch; inhaltliches und stilistisches Lektorat, Korrektorat und Fahnenkorrektur englischsprachiger Texte.
- Projects usually begin with a sample translation of two to three pages.

## Fields

Art history and art theory, philosophy, literary studies, German studies, musicology and theatre studies, history and the history of science, the social sciences, and museum and exhibition texts.

## Selected book translations

- Frauke Berndt, Vacillating Voices: Generic Ambiguity in Modern German Literature (diaphanes, 2027)
- Clemens Risi, Opera in Performance: Analyzing the Performative Dimension of Opera Productions (Routledge, 2022)
- Frauke Berndt, Facing Poetry: Alexander Gottlieb Baumgarten's Theory of Literature (De Gruyter, 2020)
- Gottfried Boehm, The Passion of Images (Walther König, 2024)
- Georg Kreis, Why Italy Was for Europe (Schwabe, 2020)
- Walter Moroder: Figures of Presence and Absence (Hatje Cantz, 2026)
- James Howell: Painting (Hatje Cantz, 2026)
- Gottfried Boehm, Sehen (Kann Verlag, 2023)

Also essays and chapters in exhibition catalogues (Fondation Beyeler: Cézanne, Jeff Wall; Josef Albers Museum Quadrat Bottrop: Josef Albers), edited volumes (Cambridge University Press, Bloomsbury, De Gruyter, J.B. Metzler, Wilhelm Fink, Palgrave Macmillan), and journals (RES: Anthropology and Aesthetics, The Germanic Review, MLN, Zeitschrift für Kunstgeschichte).

## Selected publishers and institutions

University of Chicago Press, Cambridge University Press, Yale University Press, Johns Hopkins University Press, De Gruyter, Routledge, SAGE, Bloomsbury, Wilhelm Fink, J.B. Metzler, Felix Meiner, diaphanes, Schwabe, Hatje Cantz, Walther König, Fondation Beyeler, Josef Albers Museum Quadrat Bottrop, Fondation Vincent van Gogh Arles, University of Basel, University of Zurich.

## Frequently asked

- Who translates art-historical or philosophical texts from German into English in Switzerland? Anthony Mahler, a German–English translator and editor in Basel, specialises in the humanities, art, and museum texts.
- Does he translate exhibition catalogues? Yes: catalogue essays for museums and art publishers such as the Fondation Beyeler and Hatje Cantz.
- Does he edit English texts written by German speakers, or machine translations? Yes: developmental editing, line editing, copyediting, and proofreading.
- Does he work outside Switzerland? Yes, with authors and publishers internationally.
- How does a project start? Usually with a sample translation of two to three pages.

## About

PhD in Germanic studies, University of Chicago (2014); BA, University of Pennsylvania. Postdoctoral positions in Tübingen and Zurich; research grants from the SNSF, the Mellon Foundation, and the Fulbright Program. Teaches at the Language Center of the University of Basel; based in Basel since 2012.
